comment: Error thresholds for the analytical comparison of the planar wave in the
tilted medium of material-fault1d-anisotropic.yaml, keyed by the build
configuration as in thresholds.json. They are 1.5 times the error measured
with GCC 13 for hsw, rounded up. On a mesh refined by two, the error falls
by a factor of 54, the order of the scheme; were the eigenvectors of the
initial condition inaccurate, it would stay at the 1.2e-2 they give.
